1\. Fallback keys are ignored 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
get_signing_serializer no longer supplies SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS, so cookies signed by retained
old keys fail verification and open_session silently replaces them with empty sessions.
Deployments rotating SECRET_KEY will therefore log users out despite explicitly configuring
fallback keys.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description Restore `SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS` support so sessions signed with retained old keys remain valid during secret-key rotation. ## Issue Context ItsDangerous expects keys from oldest to newest and uses the final key for new signatures. Build the serializer key list from configured fallback keys followed by the current `app.secret_key`; do not restore the removed current-key-first ordering, which could sign new cookies with an old fallback key. Retain the default configuration entry and add coverage proving old cookies verify while new cookies use the current key. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/flask/app.py[177-206] - src/flask/sessions.py[315-340] - src/flask/sessions.py[374-379] ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
